title: Four steps.
No shortcuts.

steps.d: Foam pre-soak, two-bucket hand wash, iron remover and clay. The paint gets truly clean before anything touches it.
Machine polishing levels out swirls, haze and light scratches so the clear coat reflects like glass again.
A ceramic coating or sealant locks the gloss in. Water beads, dirt lets go, and every wash after this one is easier.
A final wipe-down under inspection lights, then we walk you around the car before you drive away.

story.note: Every car goes through the same four steps, whatever the package.

servicesIntro: Every service starts with a walk-around under good light, so you know exactly what we're fixing and what it'll take.

faq.q: How long does a full detail take?
faq.a: A maintenance wash takes a few hours. Correction and coating work usually takes one to three days, depending on the car and the condition of the paint.

faq.q: Ceramic coating or wax — what's the difference?
faq.a: Wax sits on top of the paint and wears off in weeks. A ceramic coating bonds to the clear coat and lasts much longer, with stronger water beading and easier washing. We'll recommend what fits how you use the car.
Yes — we book one car at a time so nothing gets rushed. Send a request below or call, and we'll find a slot.

faq.q: How should I wash the car afterward?
faq.a: Gently: a pH-neutral soap, clean mitts and no automatic brushes. You'll get a short aftercare guide with every protection package.
